name: Bet-Rafa
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Bet-Rafa is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles 4:12 in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. The name can also be understood as 'house of Rafa' and may refer to a clan or family rather than an individual. Very little is known about this person beyond their familial connection.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Bet-Rafa is mentioned as one of the sons of Eshton in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Eshton
keyEvents.description: Eshton was the father of Bet-Rafa, Paseah, and Tehinna, the founder of Ir-Nahasj. These are counted among the men from Reka.

keyEvents.title: Part of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Bet-Rafa belongs to the broader genealogy of the tribe of Judah recorded at the beginning of 1 Chronicles, which documents the tribal history of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Lineage from Kelub
keyEvents.description: Through his father Eshton, Beth-rapha is part of a lineage that includes Kelub, the brother of Shuah, and other prominent members of the tribe of Judah.
